title: Shirazi Salad
description: The Persian table salad — cucumber, tomato, and onion in a fine dice, brightened with lemon and dill. No cooking, and better after an hour in the fridge.

ingredients.name: Persian cucumbers
ingredients.note: 1/2-inch dice; or 2 green cucumbers, peeled and seeded

ingredients.name: fresh dill
ingredients.note: chopped; cilantro, parsley, mint, or basil all work

steps.text: Toss all of the ingredients together in a large bowl. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
steps.tip: Dice everything to roughly the same size — that is what makes this salad read as one thing rather than a bowl of parts.

steps.text: Cover and refrigerate to let the flavours get to know each other.
